events.title: China Consumer Prices Flat In September
events.description: Overall consumer prices in China were flat on a seasonally adjusted monthly basis in September, the National Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Extend Winning Streak
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has moved higher in three straight sessions, advancing almost 150 points or 3 percent along the way. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,050-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 9,000.00 mark, with weakness in financial stocks partially offset by gains in mining and energy stocks.

events.title: Australia Building Consents Climb 5.1% In September
events.description: The total number of building permits issued in Australia was up a seasonally adjusted 5.1 percent on month in September, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday - coming in at 17,948.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Reverse Friday's Losses
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Friday wrote a finish to the five-day winning streak in which it had surged more than 1,825 points or 7.8 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,480-point plateau although it may move back to the upside again on Monday.

events.title: Rebound Tipped For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market on Friday snapped the two-day winning streak in which it had jumped more than 80 points or 2.2 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just beneath the 3,650-point plateau although it's likely to bounce higher again on Monday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market Poised To Halt Losing Streak
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in seven straight sessions, tumbling more than 7,275 points or 16.8 percent along the way. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 39,700-point plateau although it's overdue for support on Monday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market Overdue For Support On Monday
events.description: The Japan stock market has tracked lower in five straight sessions, sinking almost 7,200 points or 11.6 percent in that span. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 57,430-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Monday.

events.title: KOSPI In Line For Bargain Hunting On Monday
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished sharply lower in two straight sessions, crashing more than 620 points or 11 percent in that span. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,060-point plateau although it may find traction on Monday.

events.title: Australia Building Approval Data Due On Monday
events.description: Australia will on Monday release September figures for building approvals, highlighting a modest day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Advances As Investors Analyze NFP Data Amid U.S.-Iran Stalemate
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Friday as the October nonfarm payrolls came in strongly above market forecasts while the unemployment rate slumped from September numbers. In addition, the U.S.-Iran conflict continues without an end in sight triggering inflation concerns.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends Notably Lower
events.description: The Switzerland stock market ended weak on Friday after remaining in negative territory throughout the session, amid a sell-off in global equity markets amid concerns about returns on AI-related investments.

events.title: European Stocks Tumble On AI Regulation Fears
events.description: European equities fell Friday as investors worried about potential AI regulation tightening under the Trump administration and reacted to corporate earnings and economic data releases across the region.
